description: Apply surgical HTML edits (insert_before/insert_after/replace_section) to a block's localized content string without re-sending the full content. Each op's marker must match exactly once. Only call after the user confirms. If the result includes blockWarnings, the saved content violates the workspace block manifest (unknown field, wrong value shape, or a stored block whose type is no longer registered) - correct the content and save again, unless the warning is about a stored block whose type is no longer registered: that one is a manifest problem, so restore or sync the type, or find the block with list_block_usage and migrate or remove it. A block whose type the workspace block manifest does not register is refused unless the page already stores that block - pick registered types from list_block_types.

blockId.description: Content block instance id (layout blocks not supported)

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the page version you last read

operations.description: Ordered list of patch operations (applied in order)

marker.description: Unique anchor substring (must match exactly one location)

html.description: HTML fragment to replace the section with
